description.zh: 业务流程的ID，您可以调用[ListBusiness](~~173945~~)接口，根据名称查询对应业务流程的ID。
description.en: The workflow ID. You can call the [ListBusiness](~~173945~~) operation to query the workflow ID by name.

description.zh:
变更类型 
- 0：新增
- 1：更新
- 2：删除
description.en:
The change type. Valid values:

- 0: addition

- 1: update

- 2: deletion
The start date for committing. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

description.zh: 提交截止日期（包含），格式yyyy-MM-dd
description.en: The end date (included) for committing. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.
The ID of the user who commits the file.
The IDs of the files to be queried.

description.zh:
文件的代码类型。

不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集](~~600169~~)。
您也可以调用[ListFileType](~~212428~~)接口，查询文件的代码类型。
description.en:
The type of the code for the file.

The code for files varies based on the file type. For more information, see [DataWorks nodes](~~600169~~). You can call the [ListFileType](~~212428~~) operation to query the type of the code for the file.

description.zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10，最大100条。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
description.en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.
